description: Adapter-level command validation (boundary inputs). The execution adapter reads one JSON command from stdin before any build stage runs. These synthetic cases exercise the adapter's input-validation boundaries that the native feature suite never probes: a malformed/empty JSON payload normalizes to `error=invalid_json`; a command object lacking the required `stage` key normalizes to `error=missing_stage`; an unrecognized stage name normalizes to `error=unknown_stage` echoing the offending stage; and an empty-string stage is treated as a non-null but unregistered stage (distinct from a missing one). All outputs are produced purely by the JSON/stdin adapter layer, independent of any build target.
